metadata_schema.entity: Stable entity ID, aliases present in or directly derived from curated source metadata, and evidence-backed supported_facts.
metadata_schema.supported_fact: Fact key mapped to document IDs plus corpus-verbatim evidence excerpts. The loader verifies each excerpt; tags alone are not evidence.
metadata_schema.domain: Work/world identifier with multilingual aliases and optional evidence-backed terminology facts.
metadata_schema.relationship: Exact entity-ID pair or set with evidence-backed relationship facts; entity tags alone do not create an edge.
metadata_schema.fact_recognizer: Small multilingual phrase list used only to infer a candidate fact key; recognition never implies corpus support.

maintenance: After corpus changes, update corpus_version and review every entity alias and supported fact against source text.
The inventory corpus_path must resolve to the exact configured RAG_CORPUS_PATH; an example inventory must not validate a private corpus.
Add a fact key only with at least one evidence document ID; do not infer support from character or relationship tags.
Add a few multilingual query phrases only when a supported fact or observed development-case miss requires them.
Rerun development, held-out, and dense calibration after every inventory or corpus change.
